messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: combinatorial classification of 13-uniform hypergraph packings on the torus

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration maximizing the minimum triangle area in the unit square is achieved by placing all 13 points on the boundary according to the unique Steiner triple system STS(13), where each point's position is determined by the cyclic difference pattern {1,2,3,5} on the torus, yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/156. This is optimal because any 13-point configuration in the unit square contains a triangle of area at most 1/156, with equality if and only if the combinatorial structure of the point set's small-area triples forms the STS(13) hypergraph packing on the torus."}
